claude.sample_unit: patients with axial spondyloarthritis (MRI scans before and after biologic therapy)
models_evaluated: 2D U-Net (three-model averaging ensemble) with threshold-based segmentation and radiologist cleaning

links.outcome: Inter-observer segmentation overlap (Dice) with versus without AI-assisted human-machine workflow
links.effect: Median Dice improved to 0.84 with the human-machine workflow versus 0.53–0.56 inter-reader for purely manual segmentation, an increase of 28–31%.
links.quote: Using the human-machine workflow, the median Dice scores improved to 0.84, representing an increase of 28–31% compared to pure manual segmentation.

links.outcome: Model failure on atypical marrow not represented in training data; small single-site test set
links.effect: Disease-region model failed in 3 of 19 further subjects with abnormal bone marrow (high fat or sclerosis) not present in training data; test set only 2 subjects.
links.quote: The model failed in three subjects, each of whom was found to have abnormal bone marrow (high fat content or extensive sclerosis, which were not present in the training dataset).

links.outcome: Whether radiologist review of every AI preliminary segmentation corrects errors
links.effect: Inter-observer Dice after radiologist cleaning was 0.84 versus 0.60/0.55 between each reader and the preliminary uncleaned AI segmentation.
links.quote: The inter-observer Dice for the two readers using the human-machine workflow was substantially higher than the overlap between each reader and the preliminary, non-cleaned segmentation (0.60 / 0.55 for Readers 1 and 2 respectively).

unlisted_practices: Human-machine cooperative segmentation with radiologist cleaning of AI output to yield a quantitative imaging biomarker

models_evaluated: 2D U-Net convolutional neural network model averaging ensemble

links.outcome: expert cleaning of preliminary AI segmentations
links.effect: Cleaned human-machine Dice was higher than preliminary non-cleaned overlap; preliminary overlap was 0.60/0.55 for Readers 1/2.
links.quote: The inter-observer Dice for the two readers using the human-machine workflow was substantially higher than the overlap between each reader and the preliminary, non-cleaned segmentation (0.60 / 0.55 for Readers 1 and 2 respectively).

links.quote: The inter-observer Dice for the two readers using the human-machine workflow was substantially higher than the overlap between each reader and the preliminary, non-cleaned segmentation (0.60 / 0.55 for Readers 1 and 2 respectively).
